items.question: How do I find a tutor?
items.answer: Browse our tutor directory, filter by subject or expertise, view profiles, and book a session directly through our platform.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers. Payment is processed securely through our platform.

items.question: Can I become a tutor?
items.answer: Yes! If you have expertise in a subject and passion for teaching, apply through our 'Become a Tutor' page. We'll review your application within 48 hours.

items.question: How do online sessions work?
items.answer: Sessions are conducted via Zoom video conferencing. Once a tutor accepts your booking, you'll receive a meeting link to join at the scheduled time.

help.title: Need More Help?
help.subtitle: Our support team is available 24/7 to assist you

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions from students and tutors.

items.question: How do I create a student account?
items.answer: Click on Get Started, choose the student option, and complete the short sign-up form with your basic details.

items.question: How do I find the right tutor?
items.answer: Use filters on the Find Tutors page to narrow by subject, level, price, and availability, then review tutor profiles and reviews.

items.question: How are sessions conducted?
items.answer: Sessions are held online using Zoom. Once a tutor accepts your request, you'll receive a meeting link with the date and time.

items.question: Can I reschedule or cancel a session?
items.answer: Yes. You can manage upcoming sessions from your dashboard. Please review your tutor's cancellation policy before making changes.

items.question: How do I become a tutor?
items.answer: Apply through the Become a Tutor option during registration. We review your experience, subjects, and profile before approval.

items.question: How do I get more students?
items.answer: Keep your profile complete, maintain high review scores, and set clear availability so students can easily book with you.

items.question: Is my payment information secure?
items.answer: Yes. We work with trusted payment providers and never store full card details on our servers.

items.question: How is my data protected?
items.answer: We follow industry best practices for data protection. Learn more in our Privacy Policy.
